{{Top|leg}}
An '''electronic lock-picker''' was a security countermeasure device used by criminals. The [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] [[Crix Griff]] carried an electronic lock-picker,<ref name="PoG3">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Three]]''</ref> as did the [[Thief/Legends|burglar]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Rya Skodhan]] who favored a [[GenCo-3 electronic lockpicker]].<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref>
